documentation.content: Cloud Run has had 2 active instances (the --max-instances limit) for 10 minutes. The site is at capacity, which also means it is spending free-tier hours quickly. Thresholds are in deploy/monitoring/instances-maxed.json.

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type = "cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name = "__SERVICE__" AND metric.type = "run.googleapis.com/container/instance_count" AND metric.labels.state = "active"
